title: (RHBA-2020:0099) Red Hat OpenShift Container Storage 4.2 Container Image update
portal_summary: New container images for Red Hat OpenShift Container Storage 4.2 are now available in the Red Hat Container Registry.
portal_synopsis: Red Hat OpenShift Container Storage 4.2 Container Image update
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation|Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation|4|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258

The Red Hat OpenShift Container Storage 4.2 container images provided by this update can be downloaded from the Red Hat Container Registry at registry.access.redhat.com. Installation instructions for your platform are available at Red Hat Container Catalog [1]
portal_description:
Red Hat OpenShift Container Storage is software-defined storage integrated with and optimized for Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform. Red Hat OpenShift Container Storage is a highly scalable, production-grade persistent storage for stateful applications running in Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform. In addition to persistent storage, Red Hat OpenShift Container Storage provisions a multicloud data management service with an S3 compatible API.

This enhancement advisory contains the following container images for Red Hat OpenShift Container Storage 4.2. 

* OpenShift Lifecycle management operator for OpenShift Container Storage - managing the OpenShift Container Storage lifecycle. 
* OpenShift Container Storage operator -  deploys and monitors all the following containers.
* Rook-Ceph operator - managing the deployment, monitoring, and scale of a Ceph container.
* NooBaa operator - manages deployment, monitoring of NooBaa core container.
* NooBaa core container - providing data management services.  
* Ceph-CSI container - managing the Container Storage Interface for Ceph.
* "must-gather" container for OpenShift Container Storage - support and debug log collector for OpenShift Container Storage. 

All users of Red Hat OpenShift Container Storage 4.2 are advised to pull these new images from the Red Hat Container Registry.
